summary: WHISPERS: Realm of the Nine is a multiplayer dark-fantasy MMO across Lantern's March, race homelands, a battleground, and gate-linked dungeon/raid places. MMORPG Tools owns character, realm, persistence and UI lifecycle; ordered player behaviors, shared registries and data-driven combat cores run world systems, while procedural generators and place-selected looks supply presentation.
places: places/main/ - 136-cell streamed Lantern March with Lantern's Reach, race towns, quest regions and landmarks; config sets terrain, weather and a one-hour day/night cycle, sim handles room weather and Party Finder.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Lantern's Reach and Hall of Banners; guild registrar, well, merchant/farm landmarks and central routes.
places/main/cells/x-1z0.scene and neighboring woodland cells - Petalfall Hollow/March woods, glade wisps, quarry camp and quest/enemy sites.
places/main/cells/x-7z0.scene, x-9z15.scene, x2z11.scene - Deepgrove Raider, Court Brine-Taker and Phantom Current camps; placements carry crew positions, combat stats and tally keys.

places/main/cells/x2z12.scene - Gull's Wake/Captain Merrow boss placement; four fen-script teal lanterns and point lights ring the wreck; arena/home/state are placement-owned and the boss definition supplies model and scale.
places/banner-vale/ - 5v5 capture-the-banner battleground; place sim/referee handles teams, flags, scores and returns.

places/{hollowcrypt,drowned-bell,root-archive,pale-choir,emberheart,ninth-assembly}/ - gate-linked dungeon/raid instances; Hollowcrypt selects FBsRenderer look, other five use ray-traced lighting and place-specific reflection settings.
places/{character-creation-land,main-menu-land}/ - character-creation and menu environments; both use ray-traced look, with creation-land's distinct fill and reflection/bloom tuning.
roots: world.config.yaml - defaults to main-menu-land; binds player/camera templates, MMORPG UI, arrival redirect, routing, realm pulse and Awakening lighting.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/mod.json - registers MMORPG lifecycle, cameras, character/interaction behaviors and UI actions.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/version.js - GAME_VERSION 0.47.92 Alpha and newest-first Herald patch notes; version tag shown on menu, settings and pause.
templates/player.js#player - ordered locomotion, movement, class, quest, vendor, guild, guild-flag, trades, flight, vitality, cursor-free and region-music behaviors.
templates/camera.js#camera - gameplay camera; MMORPG owns separate menu and character-creation camera paths.
places/main/config.yaml and places/main/sim.js - March terrain, atmosphere/day-night cycle, Awakening frame look, room weather and Party Finder.
places/banner-vale/config.yaml and places/banner-vale/sim.js - battleground terrain and referee simulation.
places/main-menu-land/config.yaml and places/character-creation-land/config.yaml - menu/creation environment roots and spawn/atmosphere settings.
shared: mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ - RPG registries, persistence, currency, shops, soundtrack and UI modules reused by MMORPG behaviors and gameplay scripts.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/realm-save.js - character persistence, roster population and realm list/detail shared by menu and player lifecycle.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/player-panel-input.js - in-world panel actions; player.js lazily imports it after world entry; uses shop-data.js, profession-data.js and scripts/lib/talents.js.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ui-zone-splash.js - stable per-day zone art and arrival veil shared by creation loading and in-world arrival.
scripts/lib/places.js - PLAY/isPlay and SAFE_HOME registry used by quests, class actions, vitality, flight and regional music; scripts/lib/regions.js supplies REGIONS/MARCH/regionAt to music and HUD.
scripts/lib/kit.js - shared class combat, targeting, hit and talent-derived damage/cooldown helpers consumed by class cores and missile logic.
scripts/lib/talents.js - discipline trees and pick/stat helpers used by panel input, menu UI, class cores through kit.js, quest-player and scripts/lib/sheet.js.
scripts/lib/data/music.yml - regional day/night ambience and stinger catalogs consumed by scripts/region-music.js; Awakening and animacao-viva libs share water/sky and animation helpers.
notableExports: scripts/lib/places.js - PLAY, isPlay, SAFE_HOME; scripts/gen/instance.js - LAYOUTS, roomsOf, geometry.
scripts/lib/regions.js - REGIONS, MARCH, regionAt; scripts/lib/refuge.js - REFUGES, inRefuge.
scripts/lib/kit.js - power, haste, gearPower, classOf, canAct, forward, alive, aimPoint, softTargets, launch, materialOf, meleeFoley.
scripts/lib/talents.js - TREES, LEVEL_PER_POINT, MAX_POINTS, classKey, pointsEarned, picks, pointsFree, talentFx, fxText, canPick.
scripts/lib/lazy.js - lazyBehavior; scripts/lib/resident-animation.js - residentIdle, greetResident, residentPitch.

scripts/{vanguard,arcanist,pathfinder,shade}-core.js - class actions; arcanist-core.js additionally exports callStar and starLands; scripts/lib/missiles.js exports MISSILES and impactFx (also FIRE_LINGER).
scripts/lib/sheet.js - sheetOf; scripts/flight-core.js - updateSchedule, onInput, update; scripts/vitality-core.js - bloodEnds, blessEnds, onInput, updateSchedule, update.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ui-menu-panel.js - esc, buildEqTooltip, eqSlot, character/power/stats/inventory renderers and quest/spellbook/tab renderers.
ownership: scripts/player.js - room-local movement intent, velocity/footstep state, arrival _areaReady stamp and jump/landing/footstep sounds.
MMORPG player.js and lib/realm-save.js - active character, roster snapshots and persisted character records, including professions, inventory, equipment, quest state and trained rank.
MMORPG player.js - save-in-flight/retry guards and confirmed-save fingerprint; SQL and legacy roster-storage completion gate save completion.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/player-panel-input.js - in-world door/shop/profession and talent panel input transitions; MMORPG player.js owns its lazy import and supplies host helpers.
scripts/lib/talents.js - tree definitions, pick validation and derived effects; character state.unlockedTalents stores spec:tier picks, with points derived from level.
scripts/{vanguard,arcanist,pathfinder,shade}-core.js - class action/cooldown state and combat effects; wrapper scripts lazily load and forward to the corresponding core.
scripts/flight-core.js - player roost discovery, flight map and flying mount/route state; saved roosts live on character state.

scripts/region-music.js - per-session region/playlist/night ambience cursor, rain and woodlight FX id/kind; per-character discoveredZones; wolves-core.js and scavengers-core.js own AI scratch, pack/howl state and effects.
flows: world.config.yaml defaultPlace main-menu-land → main-menu-mgr/main-menu UI → realm roster or character selection → creation/enter-world → gameplay lifecycle.

Arrival outside main-menu-land without fresh _worldEnterAt or creation-place _creationEnterAt → scripts/arrival.js redirects to menu; menu/instance gates stamp allowed transitions and routing validates requested room and saved return.

main-menu-mgr loads current-room SQL roster; api.enterPlace routes selected character to saved place/position; realms.yml feeds routing.js and realm-pulse cron, which writes realm_pulse for realm-save to read.
Character creation race/class → lib/races.js start and character state → MMORPG player.js/realm-save upsert characters keyed by user, realm and slot.
Creation confirm → character-select.js loadingScreen/progress; local _loadProg animates and loadingProgress patches coarsely → ui.js renders ui-zone-splash.js art/arrivalVeil.
Creation/first arrival → ui.js uses ui-zone-splash.js; veil waits for scripts/player.js _areaReady after stable grounded terrain contact or MAX_WAIT, then holds/fades.

templates/player.js behavior order → locomotion → movement → class handlers → quest-player → vendor → guild → guild-flag → trades → flight → vitality → cursor-free → region-music; MMORPG player.js/wow-move.js consume movement/camera intent.
MMORPG player.js dynamically imports lib/player-panel-input.js after a created hero enters a non-meta place; panel module uses shop-data.js, profession-data.js and scripts/lib/talents.js.

ui-menu-panel.js renders talents from scripts/lib/talents.js → spendTalent/resetTalents handled by player-panel-input.js → state.unlockedTalents; class cores/kit and quest-player derive combat, cooldown and health effects.
ui-menu-panel.js character tab → scripts/lib/sheet.js sheetOf(state) reads level, equipment, training and talents → displays derived character stats without owning character state.

Class wrappers lazily load matching cores; HUD maps spell slots to per-class action ids; class cores and missile effects produce action/impact FX, with arcanist spells and class-specific ground impacts handled by their respective core/data.

places/main atmosphere.timeOfDay → region-music.js selects music.yml night ambience/stingers and creates per-player camera-following forest fireflies/wisps or day motes by zone; enemy cores update their placed actors.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/instance.js - reused across instance places, varied by layout (room dimensions, corridor length, materials/colors) and kind; floor roughness is layout-specific for traced reflections.

scripts/boss-core.js + scripts/lib/data/bosses.yml - one AI across dungeon/raid and open-world placements, varied by definition: hp, arena, abilities/telegraphs, phases, enrage, rewards, model and scale; Drowned Echo model layout bounds now specify 1.85 m height.
scripts/gen/flora.js - seeded flora across March roads, race-town beds, Reedhaven cottage gardens and Thornhollow bloom clearings; kind, palette, seed, scale and density vary.
scripts/gen/house.js - generated cottages/halls share house geometry with width/depth, roof, chimney and window parameters; cottage weathering/detail differs from stone halls.
scripts/gen/homeland.js - landmarks/foliage reused at homeland encounter sites, varied by kind (hollow, vault, reedcage, bloom), scale and seed.
scripts/gen/{ashen,ashen-village,grave-ground}.js - Ashen Close graveyard, cathedral yard, gothic village pieces and cover; helper, kind, seed, LOD and dimensions vary.
scripts/gen/fen.js and scripts/gen/tree.js - seeded marsh props/boardwalks and March pines/oaks/dead trees recur across regions; kind, seed, LOD and dimensions vary.

scripts/lib/missiles.js + class cores - data/ability-driven missile and strike FX vary by class, element and impact surface; class-specific ground hits add effects such as colored light, rings, embers and lingering marks.
probableOrphans: scripts/gen/grave-weeds.js - no scene or other package reference; graveyard cover is currently placed through grave-ground.js instead.
migrationNotes: Adding a playable place requires a row in scripts/lib/places.js PLAY; dying heroes rise at SAFE_HOME for listed dungeons/raids. Quest and class logic uses isPlay rather than hard-coded place names.

Instance room walls/corridors and scene furnishing placement share layout coordinates: entry is z=0, chambers chain toward -Z, floor y=0; keep scripts/gen/instance.js roomsOf arithmetic consistent with scenes.
Gate links are explicit +place#object links on paired gates; instance-gate checks minLevel and active enterQuest, stamps _worldEnterAt for arrival.js, then counts enterTally.

Creation and first-arrival veils use ui-zone-splash.js zoneArtFor/arrivalVeil; scripts/player.js stamps _areaReady after stable grounded terrain contact and splash retains its wait/hold/fade contract.

Talent picks are state.unlockedTalents entries keyed spec:tier, not flat tier numbers; points derive from floor(level/5), max 12, with one pick per tier in a spec; kit.js and quest-player.js consume derived effects.

Lantern March audio reads live atmosphere.timeOfDay; keep the one-hour cycle and music.yml night thresholds aligned. Captain Merrow's wreck strand has four seeded fen lantern placements with matching teal lights; Drowned Echo's explicit model layout extents are x ±0.4, z ±0.3, y 0..1.85 m.
